title: cyanea calycina
intro: Cyanea calycina, commonly known as the Hawaiian Blue Sage, is a flowering plant native to the Hawaiian Islands. This plant is known for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Cyanea calycina include its ability to exhibit antimicrobial, antifungal, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
